title: A sealed Result type for parsing ages

blocks.text: The page recommends sealed interfaces for API contracts: the library fixes the set of implementations, so every caller can handle all of them with an exhaustive `switch`, and no client can add a surprise variant. `Ages` offers such a contract:

sealed interface Result permits Ok, Err
record Ok(int value)       record Err(String message)

items: `Err("not a number: " + text)` when `text` is not an integer;
`Err("out of range: " + value)` when the integer is below 0 or above 150;
`static Result sumAges(List<String> texts)`: parse every text in order. If all are `Ok`, return `Ok` of their sum (`Ok(0)` for no texts); otherwise return the `Err` of the **first** text that failed.

blocks.text: Handle each `Result` with a `switch`; `Result` is sealed, so no `default` is needed.

cases.says: A valid age parses to Ok, text that is no number parses to Err, and valid ages sum to Ok.
0 and 150 are ages; -1 and 151 are Err results naming the value.
When several ages are bad, the sum reports the first bad one.

concepts: A sealed interface gives an API a closed contract: callers can handle every implementation, and clients cannot add one.
